Veterinary technicians and assistants could be tasked with evaluating breeder operations and documenting animal health status to meet licensing requirements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Official Code of Georgia Annotated; various provisions enacted prior to 2013 which are contingent upon funding and which remain unfunded; repeal
bills.summary_ai: This Georgia bill amends the Georgia Veterinary Practice Act by repealing unfunded provisions enacted prior to 2013. While the specific unfunded provisions are not detailed in the bill description, any changes to the Veterinary Practice Act could affect scope of practice, supervision requirements, or delegation authority for veterinary paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Crimes and offenses; change references to assistance and guide dogs to service dogs
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes legal protections and penalties related to service dogs, including criminal penalties for harming service dogs and penalties for misrepresenting service dog needs. It requires definitions and regulations around service dog training and use, which directly impacts veterinary professionals who may be involved in service dog health care, training oversight, or medical certification.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: State veterinary education; biomedical technicians to be eligible for the state student loan forgiveness program; provide
bills.last_action: House Committee Favorably Reported By Substitute
bills.summary_ai: This Georgia bill expands state student loan forgiveness program eligibility to include biomedical technicians in veterinary education. The legislation aims to support the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by providing financial incentives for education and retention.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; authorize licensed veterinary technicians to administer antirabies vaccinations to animals
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands the scope of practice for licensed veterinary technicians in Georgia by authorizing them to administer antirabies vaccinations to animals under direct veterinary supervision, rather than requiring a licensed veterinarian to perform this task. This delegation of duties aims to improve workforce efficiency and access to rabies vaccination services.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians and Veterinary Technicians; licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to practice veterinary teleadvice; authorize
bills.summary_ai: This bill authorizes licensed veterinarians and veterinary technicians to practice veterinary teleadvice and teletriage services, and veterinarians to practice telemedicine, while establishing regulatory oversight by the State Board of Veterinary Medicine. The legislation directly expands the scope of practice for veterinary technicians by permitting remote advisory and triage services.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians; practice and provision of veterinary teletriage and veterinary telemedicine; revise provisions
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends Georgia law to revise provisions governing how veterinarians and veterinary technicians can provide teletriage and telemedicine services. The legislation directly impacts the scope of practice and permitted activities for veterinary paraprofessionals in remote care delivery.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the licensing and supervision requirements for veterinary technicians and veterinary technologists, defining what services they can perform under veterinarian supervision and establishing veterinarian responsibility for their work. It also specifies which services are restricted to licensed veterinarians only.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by establishing a new registration pathway for veterinary professional associates (VPA), requiring the Department of Business and Professional Regulation to issue certificates of registration and maintain a public registry. The bill also modifies telehealth prescription regulations and includes provisions for disciplinary action against registered VPAs.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates a new veterinary paraprofessional credential called 'veterinary professional associate' (VPA) and establishes registration requirements through the Department of Business and Professional Regulation. It defines the scope of practice for VPAs, including what actions they are prohibited from taking, and addresses telehealth prescription authority.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the regulation of veterinary technicians by establishing licensure requirements, continuing education standards, scope of practice permissions, and disciplinary procedures. It also defines the relationship between licensed veterinary technicians and supervising veterinarians, including what tasks can be delegated and what actions are prohibited.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
bills.regulatory_type: scope of practice, licensure, continuing education, discipline, delegation

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary service access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enabling telehealth for urgent conditions. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure, it indirectly affects paraprofessionals by potentially expanding the scope of services available and may influence supervision requirements and delegation of tasks under telehealth arrangements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill regulates how veterinary care providers, including paraprofessionals, can handle medical credit cards and payment practices. It prohibits advertising medical credit cards, receiving incentives for promoting them, and charging for services before delivery or ancillary products without separate consent.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends state law protections for health care providers and patients related to legally protected health care activities. Depending on implementation, it could affect veterinary paraprofessionals' ability to perform delegated tasks and protect them from liability when acting within their scope of practice.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses the continuation and licensing of pet animal care facilities under state agricultural oversight, which directly impacts where veterinary paraprofessionals work and the regulatory environment governing their employment. The sunset review may implement changes to facility standards, licensing requirements, or operational rules that affect veterinary technicians and other paraprofessionals employed in these facilities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses increasing access to veterinary care through streamlined veterinarian licensing by endorsement and clarifies the use of prescription and compounded drugs by veterinarians. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it relates to paraprofessional workforce by potentially expanding the scope of drugs and services available through veterinary practices, which could affect delegation of duties to veterinary technicians and assistants.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill regulates cat declawing procedures under veterinary medicine law by amending the Business and Professions Code. It establishes restrictions or requirements around declawing as a surgical procedure that veterinary professionals may perform.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 313, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes new procedures and criteria for background checks and criminal history information across multiple professions and occupations regulated by the state. It likely affects veterinary paraprofessionals who may be subject to background check requirements for employment or licensure in veterinary settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is a critical public health and animal health issue that directly impacts veterinary practice protocols and medication use. Veterinary paraprofessionals are frequently involved in administering medications, documenting drug use, and implementing infection control measures, making them key players in antimicrobial stewardship efforts.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California law to modify the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants, defining what tasks and procedures these professionals are legally authorized to perform. The legislation directly impacts the legal boundaries and responsibilities of veterinary paraprofessionals in clinical practice.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 205, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine regulations by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code, including adding new sections and repealing others. The extensive amendments to sections governing veterinary practice and professional requirements directly impact the regulatory framework for veterinary paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends regulations governing the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is the foundational legal requirement that establishes when veterinarians can delegate tasks to paraprofessionals. Changes to VCPR requirements directly impact what duties veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and assistants are permitted to perform under veterinary supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends the Veterinary Medical Board's regulatory code across multiple sections governing veterinary practice, licensure, and professional standards. The amendments likely address scope of practice, supervision requirements, and regulatory oversight of veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This appropriations bill allocates funding to the Department of Education's Division of Higher Education for fiscal year 2026-2027, which directly impacts educational programs that prepare veterinary paraprofessionals. Adequate funding for higher education institutions is essential for maintaining and expanding veterinary technician, technologist, and nurse training programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight requirements for veterinary practices, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals can be employed, supervised, and utilized within those practice settings. The regulatory framework for practice ownership and oversight determines the operational structure within which all veterinary paraprofessional categories must work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses the classification and legal definitions of animal abuse and neglect, which directly impacts the professional responsibilities and reporting obligations of veterinary paraprofessionals who encounter suspected cases in clinical practice. Veterinary staff are often mandated reporters of animal abuse and neglect, making understanding these legal classifications essential to their role.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses alternative pathways for veterinary technician education and certification, potentially expanding how individuals can qualify and become certified as veterinary paraprofessionals beyond traditional accredited programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses certification and education pathways for veterinary technicians, establishing alternative routes to achieve professional certification beyond traditional educational requirements. It directly impacts credential recognition and professional standards for veterinary paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes funding and programs for spay and neuter services, which are routine surgical procedures commonly performed by veterinary technicians and assistants under veterinarian supervision. The program's implementation will likely increase demand for paraprofessional workforce involvement in these procedures across the state.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes temporary licensing provisions for regulated professions, which could allow veterinary paraprofessionals to practice under temporary permits before obtaining full licensure or credentials. This mechanism could facilitate workforce entry and address staffing shortages in veterinary clinics.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing veterinary licensure and examination in the state. The extension ensures continued regulatory oversight of veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals under the board's jurisdiction.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary professional licenses for certain professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals who need to practice while awaiting full licensure or during workforce shortages. Temporary permits would allow veterinary technicians, assistants, and other paraprofessionals to work under specific conditions before completing standard licensing requirements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a pet and service animal disaster emergency plan involving veterinarians and veterinarian technicians. It requires coordination between the Alaska State Emergency Response Commission and local emergency planning committees to ensure veterinary professionals can respond to disaster situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines (working/military dogs) and modifies veterinary medicine practice laws, including the powers and duties of veterinarians and their liability protections. It directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals by potentially expanding scope of practice and clarifying delegation authority for emergency care of working dogs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates funding mechanisms including tuition grants and loan forgiveness for allied health professionals in rural areas through the Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act. Veterinary paraprofessionals working in rural settings may be eligible for educational financial support to address workforce shortages.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill defines and clarifies the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which directly impacts what tasks and responsibilities can be delegated to veterinary paraprofessionals. By specifying veterinarian scope, it establishes the boundaries within which all listed paraprofessional categories must operate.
